evals.name: new-evm-minimal
evals.prompt: I want to bootstrap a new Effectstream template called `my-evm-rooms` from scratch. Just EVM (Hardhat local for dev, no mainnet config yet), no batcher, no frontend yet, no tests yet — just the skeleton that boots with `bun run dev`. The state machine should have one custom action `createRoom(roomName: string up to 32 chars, maxPlayers: number 2-8)` that writes to a `rooms` table. Also create the Dockerfile. Put the template at `/tmp/eval-runs/my-evm-rooms/`. After you write everything, list the files you created and explain the key sharp edges you avoided (or hit) — especially around workspace resolution, contract address timing, and Docker.
evals.expected_output: Complete file tree at /tmp/eval-runs/my-evm-rooms/ with root package.json (workspaces, effectstream.default, build:pgtypes, build:evm scripts; @midnight-ntwrk/wallet-sdk-address-format dep), start.dev.ts using { cwd } not { resolveFrom }, packages/contracts-evm/ with hardhat config + Solidity extending EffectstreamL2Contract, packages/database/ with migrations/sql/migration-order/mod.ts, packages/node/grammar.ts (Typebox), config.dev.ts (ConfigBuilder NTP + EVM_RPC_PARALLEL), state-machine.ts (Stm with createRoom transition using World.resolve), api.ts, main.dev.ts, Dockerfile with workspace-symlink workaround + procps/lsof/iproute2 + Foundry + pre-cached solc.

evals.name: new-multichain-evm-midnight
evals.prompt: Help me set up a new Effectstream template called `mint-and-mint` that targets BOTH EVM (Hardhat for dev, Arbitrum for mainnet) AND Midnight. Users mint an ERC-721 on the EVM side and a corresponding Midnight contract increments a counter. I want a batcher (EVM only — Midnight tx is a one-shot from the user's wallet later), a Vite/React frontend that subscribes to a custom `NftMinted` app event, full Phase A/B/C tests including the Playwright render test, mainnet configs, and a Dockerfile. I need the orchestrator config (`start.dev.ts`), the root `package.json`, the batcher entry+factory files, the Dockerfile, the frontend's `vite.config.ts`, AND `packages/shared/app-events.ts` written out. I'll fill in the rest. Save everything to `/tmp/eval-runs/mint-and-mint/`. Point out the gotchas you've handled — especially anything Midnight-specific, the Vite browser polyfills, and the batcher signature thing.
evals.expected_output: Files at /tmp/eval-runs/mint-and-mint/: root package.json (nested workspace for contracts-midnight/contract-round-value, @midnight-ntwrk/wallet-sdk-address-format dep, all build:* scripts), start.dev.ts using { cwd } for both launchEvm AND launchMidnight (with MIDNIGHT_STORAGE_PASSWORD passing 3-of-4 complexity), batcher/effectstream-l2.ts + batcher.dev.ts + batcher.mainnet.ts (namespace=appName, fluent Pattern B preferred, env var validation in mainnet), Dockerfile with xz-utils + Compact compiler install + Foundry + workspace symlink workaround, vite.config.ts (NO vite-plugin-top-level-await, native-fetch-shim alias for node-fetch, fix-stream-web plugin enforce:pre, VITE_IS_BUN consideration), packages/shared/app-events.ts with registerEvents + genEvent + indexed fields. Should mention Midnight version pinning, namespace==appName rule, node-fetch shim, Bun MQTT/VITE_IS_BUN, workspace symlinks needed in Docker, --depth=0 remappings, dynamic-import patterns for DISABLE_MIDNIGHT.

evals.name: migrate-paimaexample-chess
evals.prompt: I have an old `@paimaexample/*` chess template at `/tmp/eval-runs/legacy-chess/` (don't actually look for the files — they don't exist, just assume the standard old chess layout: packages/client/node/{src/main.ts, src/state-machine.ts, src/api.ts, scripts/start.ts}, packages/client/database/, packages/shared/data-types/src/{grammar.ts, localhostConfig.ts}, packages/shared/contracts/evm/, packages/shared/game-logic/{tick.ts, round_executor.ts, match_executor.ts, chess-logic.ts}, packages/frontend/ with Oak server, @ts-rest API, PaimaSTM, the [PreparedQuery, params] tuple pattern in state-machine.ts). Walk me through the migration to effectstream-v2 — give me a concrete, ordered, file-level plan with the exact transformations. Cover: what gets renamed (packages, classes, files), what gets flattened, what gets deleted entirely, what gets inlined (game logic into STM), the workspace.json + scripts changes, the new files I need to create (start.dev.ts, config.dev.ts/config.mainnet.ts, main.dev.ts/main.mainnet.ts, packages/tests/, Dockerfile). Save the plan as `/tmp/eval-runs/legacy-chess-migration-plan.md`.
